{{Article header|section=Mining|context=Modules|deck=Upcoming Rhino scanner used to locate planetary mining deposits.}}

The '''Planetary Mineral Scanner''' is announced equipment associated with the [[Rhino]] [[Surface Recon Vehicles|Surface Recon Vehicle]] and [[Surface Mining]]. Frontier has stated that the Rhino comes equipped with the scanner and uses it to detect planetary mining deposits.<ref name="frontier-august-dev-log">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments, 27 August 2026.</ref>

== Function ==

According to Frontier's August 2026 developer log, the Planetary Mineral Scanner identifies mineral patches while the Rhino is on a planetary surface. The scanner marks deposits both on the planetary surface and on sensors so the Rhino and its crew can set up for extraction.<ref name="frontier-august-dev-log" />

Frontier has not yet published enough released-game detail to document scanner range, interface controls, tuning, engineering, prices, or compatibility outside the Rhino.
